ov: الهوائيات هو فيلم خيال علمي إماراتي صدر في عام 2016، وهو من إخراج علي زيدي، ومن بطولة ساغا الياسري وآنا دروزينينا.
plotEn: Earth is invaded by aliens from outer space. A multiracial couple living in the city of Dubai are confined to their home due to the uncertainty of the situation. Disconnected from the world outside due to the loss of communication, they explore their cultural differences in science in order to understand the reason behind aliens coming to our planet, only to find themselves confronted by a pair of extraterrestrial encounters at their home.
